description: Recognizes a request to start a new WinUI application rather than restore an existing one.
prompt: Help me start Orris Clock as a new C# WinUI 3 app from this sketch. The dev tools are installed; I need the initial project.

paraphrases.novice: I have a sketch for Orris Clock but no code yet. Can you make the starting C# project using WinUI 3 so I can begin working on it?
paraphrases.terse: New Orris Clock app: C#, WinUI 3. Scaffold from attached sketch.
